Package ca.mcgill.ecse321.gameorganizer.dto

Class ReviewResponseDto

java.lang.Object
ca.mcgill.ecse321.gameorganizer.dto.ReviewResponseDto
public class ReviewResponseDto extends Object
DTO for representing review data in API responses. Contains review details and associated game and reviewer information.
